Vitamin C injections in Brooklyn: two published prices under $100

Quick answer: W8MD publishes a vitamin C intramuscular (IM) injection starting at $30 in Sheepshead Bay. Allergy & Asthma Care of Brooklyn publishes a $45 vitamin C injection, but its separately listed one-time nurse consultation is $40 for non-allergy patients, making the listed first-visit components $85 before any other charges. Prices and appointment availability must be confirmed directly with each clinic.

This is an independent editorial comparison. Neither clinic is represented as a paying advertiser, a verified lead recipient, or an endorsed provider. A callback from this guide is not a booking with either clinic.

Which is closer to Bed-Stuy or 251 Tompkins Avenue?

The Plaza Street East location near Grand Army Plaza is geographically closer to Bedford-Stuyvesant than W8MD's Sheepshead Bay office. Exact travel time depends on your starting point and transit conditions; check a current route before booking. We have not verified another nearby Brooklyn clinic offering standalone vitamin C IM injections at a published price.

Five questions before you pay

  1. Is this a vitamin C intramuscular injection rather than an IV drip, IV push, or an add-on?
  2. What is the total first-visit price, including consultation, supplies, and administration?
  3. What dose and formulation will be used, and is it in stock on the appointment date?
  4. Who screens kidney history, medications, allergies, pregnancy status when relevant, and whether an injection is appropriate?
  5. Can I book directly, and what is the cancellation policy?

Vitamin C injection vs. IV drip

An IM injection is administered into a muscle; an IV infusion goes into a vein. An inexpensive injection should not be presented as a vitamin C IV drip. The routes have different fees, procedures, and risks. Neither method is automatically preferable to oral vitamin C, and neither is a substitute for evaluation of persistent symptoms or nutritional deficiency.

How this comparison was compiled

We checked the two clinics' own published service and pricing pages on October 28, 2026. We included only Brooklyn providers with a public vitamin C injection price and an identifiable Brooklyn address.
